title: AgentOffice Action Envelope
description: Standard message on the shared Office Redis bus (Office agents + all team agents)

actor.description: Who sent the action. Office agents: architect, staff-engineer, scrum-master, super-devops. Team agents use team-qualified ids when needed, e.g. dev-crew-1/developer, lab-crew-1/research-lead. Also: lifecycle, external, system.

action.description: Action type. Examples: project.created, project.assigned, research.started, research.ready, implementation.started, handoff.requested, handoff.accepted, handoff.rejected, promotion.requested, promotion.completed, task.started, task.finished, task.stale, project.blocked, agent.started, agent.stopped, agent.wake, agent.wake_failed, override.recorded, audit.started, capacity.changed

target.description: Recipient: agent id, team id, project id, or '*' (broadcast)

team.description: Optional team instance id when the action is scoped to a factory instance

project.description: Optional project id when the action is about a portfolio item
